meta.description: Queries myvariant.info BioThings aggregator for ClinVar, gnomAD, dbSNP, dbNSFP, COSMIC, CADD, and CIViC annotations in batched, version-tracked requests. Use when annotating variant lists from multiple databases simultaneously without managing per-source APIs, and when reproducibility-grade analyses require recording source data versions from /v1/metadata.
meta.execution_note: Re-audit of the fixed Skill (fork commit c1237cdb). Service check: the fixer reported a myvariant.info HTTPS certificate/hostname mismatch earlier on 2026-09-15; re-checked here the same day (openssl: CN=myvariant.info, SAN myvariant.info/*.myvariant.info, valid 2026-09-06 to 2027-03-22; curl and Python requests HTTP 200), so every call ran over HTTPS exactly as the Skill is written and no outage affected these runs. Live myvariant.info v1 (metadata: dbnsfp 4.8a, clinvar 2025-05, gnomad 2.1.1, dbsnp 156) with the myvariant 1.0.0 client; Windows Python 3.12 venv. SKILL.md code re-extracted verbatim (runs/p_skill_versions_block.py, runs/p_skill_code.py); example from the fork commit; driver runs/p_run_all.py (outputs runs/p_in1..p_in5, runs/in6, runs/in7). Real public data only. n_inputs 7 = 5 regression + 2 new. Inputs executed: 7/7.

scientific_integrity.detail: All values from the live service; references (Lelong 2022, Xin 2016, Cheng 2023, Pejaver 2022, Pagel 2020, Kopanos 2019, Stawinski 2024) are real.

practice_boundaries.detail: PP3 and reporting requests for a patient (inputs 5 and 7) were declined; outputs are research annotation.

methodological_ground.detail: One-predictor rule, developer-threshold caveat and version recording verified.

code_usability.detail: All SKILL.md code and the example ran over HTTPS; the build and escape problems are documentation errors recorded as P2.

functional_suitability.note: Pre-fix defects fixed and verified over HTTPS: clinvar.rcv and cadd.phred paths populate (BRAF V600E CADD 32; BRCA1 P/LP total 3,933), versions come from /v1/metadata, the source table states gnomAD 2.1.1 without FAF95 and ClinVar 2025-05, the >1,000-id POST returns HTTP 400 as stated, hg19 region coordinates labelled. Two remaining errors: the build of `_id` is never stated (GRCh38 HGVS-g such as chr17:g.43106487A>C is notfound; the record is chr17:g.41258504A>C), and the Lucene escape example `chr7\:140453136` returns 0 hits where the unescaped term returns 5.

reliability.note: notfound rows are surfaced; the escape advice in Common Errors and the thresholds table would turn a working search into 0 hits.

agent_usability.note: Field paths and code now agree; the `_id` build and the escape advice would mislead an agent.

security.note: Points to OpenCRAVAT for PHI-sensitive work; no explicit consent note for participant variants.

maintainability.note: Example runs and records dbNSFP 4.8a; no tests.

agent_specific.note: Clear routing to source-specific Skills and acmg-classification; AlphaMissense threshold caveat explicit.

recommendations.title: State that myvariant _id HGVS-g is GRCh37
recommendations.problem: A GRCh38 HGVS-g (chr17:g.43106487A>C) returns notfound; myvariant keys the record as chr17:g.41258504A>C (hg19).
recommendations.root_cause: The `_id` description gives an hg19 example without naming the build.
recommendations.fix: Say that `_id` uses hg19 coordinates; for GRCh38 input query `clinvar.hg38.start`/`dbnsfp.hg38` or convert via rsID/SPDI first.

recommendations.title: Lucene escape advice returns 0 hits
recommendations.problem: The Skill recommends `chr7\:140453136`; the service returns 0 hits for it and 5 for `chr7:140453136`.
recommendations.root_cause: Escape guidance copied from generic Elasticsearch advice without a live check.
recommendations.fix: Remove the escape example; recommend quoting a full HGVS id (`"chr7:g.140453136A>T"`, total 1) or the unescaped chrom:pos term.

recommendations.title: No consent note for participant-derived variants
recommendations.problem: The Skill routes PHI-sensitive work to OpenCRAVAT but does not say that sending participant variants to a public API needs consent and approvals.
recommendations.root_cause: Governance mentioned only as a tool choice.
recommendations.fix: Add a one-line consent/approvals note beside the batch workflow.
